description: Java interface 'SessionedJsonifiable' defining methods for obtaining JSON representations and session-related information for streaming sessions, including static factory methods for creating instances with different types of data such as signals, errors, responses, subscription events, and acknowledgments.

classes.name: SessionedJsonifiable
classes.description: An interface for JSON objects with session-related information, capable of producing JSON representations, headers, and handling different scenarios like signals, errors, responses, subscription events, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the Jsonifiable object associated with the sessioned object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with this sessioned JSON object.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves extra fields for the Jsonifiable based on session information, possibly returning an empty JSON object or a failed future.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the StreamingSession if it exists for this Jsonifiable.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Static factory method to create a SessionedJsonifiable for a given Signal, with specified session headers and session data.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Static factory method to create a SessionedJsonifiable representing an error, based on a DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Static factory method to create a SessionedJsonifiable for a command response.

methods.name: subscription
methods.description: Static factory method to create a SessionedJsonifiable for a SubscriptionEvent as a response.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Static factory method to create a SessionedJsonifiable for a streaming acknowledgment, specifying streaming type, subscription status, and connection correlation ID.
